subject: Post-discovery — engineer intake & 75-minute architecture session
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mason <alex@quantiflow.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@quantiflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery — engineer intake & 75-minute architecture session

Thanks again for the call this morning — clear product fit, and good next step is a focused engineering session so our infra and ops teams can validate integration surface and perf targets.

Proposed goal: a 60–90 minute architecture session (we typically do 75m) to cover data shape, serving options, and rollout constraints so we can produce a scoped mutual action plan.

Possible windows (PDT):
- Thu 2027-07-22, 10:00–11:15
- Fri 2027-07-23, 16:00–17:15
- Mon 2027-07-26, 09:00–10:15

Please confirm: 1) preferred slot, 2) attendee list from your side (we recommend your Data Eng lead + the engineer who owns production infra), and 3) any hard constraints (data residency / compliance items we should prep for).

Suggested agenda (draft):
1) 10m — quick introductions & goals
2) 20m — data volumes, shapes, and ingest pattern (sample files welcome)
3) 20m — model serving options (model sizes, quantization, caching) + latency/cost tradeoffs
4) 15m — authentication, logging, audit expectations (SSO, KMS, retention)
5) 10m — next steps / mutual action plan

I've attached a short discovery notes export and a preflight checklist our ops team will use — if you can drop a small sample schema (CSV) that will speed calibration.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Sofia — thanks, that sounds perfect.

Fri 2027-07-23 16:00 PDT works best for our team. I'll have Priya and our Data Eng lead Samir Rao join.

Quick note on scope: we ingest hourly batches (~150k rows) today and run batched scoring; we're interested in both nearline and low-latency options (p95 under 200ms if possible for a subset of calls). Happy to share a sanitized sample csv (will send via Drive link).

Please pencil us for 7/23 16:00 PDT and we'll accept the calendar invite when it comes through.

—

Looping in from infra: Arun Patel (infra lead) will attend from our side. 75 minutes is ideal — gives room for a quick demo and a focused Q&A.

- a representative sample schema and a small anonymized CSV (<=10MB)
- expected peak concurrent requests and p95 latency targets for the low-latency path
- any compliance constraints (EU data, HIPAA fields, etc.)
